zh.siteTagline: AI 肤质检测 · 护肤方案
zh.heroTitle: AI 智能肤质检测，科学护肤每一步
zh.heroDesc: 小树美容基于 AI 技术，提供专业皮肤检测与个性化护肤方案。多维度评估、护肤计划与趋势分析，让护肤更科学。
zh.downloadCta: 在 iOS App Store 中搜索「小树美容」下载
zh.featuresSubtitle: AI 检测 · 护肤方案 · 档案管理
zh.featureDetectDesc: 约 3 秒完成全面皮肤分析：光滑度、出油、毛孔、肤色与皮肤年龄；真人活体检测确保分析准确。
zh.featurePlanDesc: 即时建议、短期 1–4 周计划、长期 1–3 个月抗衰护理；饮食、睡眠、运动与产品推荐，一应俱全。
zh.featureReportDesc: 详细皮肤评估、清晰图表、分享与导出；支持按日期、分数等多维度筛选与历史追踪。
zh.featurePrivacyDesc: 数据本地存储、不上传云端；照片仅用于分析，符合苹果隐私政策，你的数据你做主。
zh.aboutDesc: 小树美容致力于让专业肤质分析与护肤方案触手可及。借助 AI 与多维度评估，助您科学护肤、追踪肤质变化。
zh.disclaimerText: 本应用提供的护肤建议仅供参考，不能替代专业皮肤科诊断与治疗。

en.heroDesc: Treelet Beauty uses AI for professional skin analysis and personalized skincare. Multi-dimensional assessment, plans, and trend reports for smarter skincare.
en.downloadCta: Search "Treelet Beauty" in the iOS App Store to download
en.featuresSubtitle: AI detection · Skincare plans · Profile management
en.featureDetectDesc: Full skin analysis in about 3 seconds: smoothness, oiliness, pores, tone, and skin age; live detection for accurate results.
en.featurePlanDesc: Instant tips, 1–4 week short-term plans, 1–3 month anti-aging plans; diet, sleep, exercise, and product recommendations included.
en.featureReportDesc: Detailed assessment, clear charts, share and export; filter by date, score, and more; track history and trends.
en.featurePrivacyDesc: Data stored locally, not uploaded to the cloud; photos used only for analysis. Compliant with Apple privacy; your data, your control.
en.aboutDesc: Treelet Beauty makes professional skin analysis and skincare plans accessible. With AI and multi-dimensional evaluation, we help you care for your skin scientifically.
en.disclaimerText: Skincare advice in this app is for reference only and does not replace professional dermatological diagnosis or treatment.
